claims.statement: The guide was developed to help design and implement CHW curricula to strengthen essential community services within primary health care.
claims.quote: This guide was developed to assist in the conceptualization, design and implementation of CHW curricula with a view to strengthening delivery of essential services at community level as an integral part of primary health care.
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: The main audience is CHW educators and those developing CHW curricula.
claims.quote: The main target audience for this document comprises CHW educators as well those developing CHW curricula.
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: Most volunteer or very part-time CHWs cannot carry out all the universal practice activities in the framework.
claims.quote: Most volunteer CHWs, or those working only a few hours a week, cannot reasonably carry out all the universal practice activities expected of all CHWs in this framework.
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: The guide has six competency domains, 12 universal modules and four role-specific modules with 28 topics.
claims.quote: The content is organized into six competency domains, 12 universal modules (11 practice activities plus one module of basic science knowledge), and four role-specific modules, comprising 28 role-specific topics organized under the four modules.
claims.locator: 3.1 Overview of the CHW curriculum guide
claims.reason: every citation quotes the source exactly

claims.statement: For role-specific activities, planners are advised to select only the modules relevant to their health system.
claims.quote: For the role-specific activities, programme managers or CHW educators are advised to select only the relevant modules appropriate to their health system.

claims.statement: The guide recommends that practising CHWs receive a financial package matched to job demands, hours, training and roles.
claims.quote: Providing practising CHWs with a financial package commensurate with the job demands, complexity, number of hours worked, training and roles that they undertake.
claims.locator: 4. Health policy and health system support for CHW integration in primary health care
